Keywords: Stops and lodging at the Vilnia confluence
RagShortTexts: The Vilnia and Neris confluence helped travelers identify routes and landings.
Loaded boats and driven animals used different routes and needed water and lodging reports.

Variants.Content: The Vilnia joins the Neris at a recognizable route point. Banks, paths and landing places shaped stopping there. Travelers asked residents about water and lodging; loaded boats and people driving animals could require different routes.

The Vilnia joins the Neris at a recognizable route point. Banks, paths and landing places shaped stopping there. Travelers asked residents about water and lodging; loaded boats and people driving animals could require different routes. A crossing could separate the advance party from baggage, requiring escorts to watch both banks and the remaining column. Urgency could not replace boats or workable water.
